title: Read the Contract
prompt: Implement read_project(pyproject_text) that parses TOML text (tomllib.loads) and returns a dict with keys name, version, and scripts (the [project.scripts] table).

tests.name: extracts identity
tests.code:
text = '''[project]
name = "toolkit"
version = "1.2.0"

[project.scripts]
toolkit = "toolkit.cli:main"'''
info = read_project(text)
assert info['name'] == 'toolkit'
assert info['version'] == '1.2.0'
assert info['scripts'] == {'toolkit': 'toolkit.cli:main'}

tests.name: missing scripts yields empty dict
tests.hint: Use .get with a default — absence is normal.
